focusedAudit.reason: A Beta release; no exact-tree release audit was run for this Beta; explicit deferral, not certification.

items.text: Every property Tine gives its own meaning is now named `tine.<name>`, so your own properties with the same name stay yours (Discussion #825). A child bullet with your own `quote::` no longer turns into a margin comment, and an `author::` in your book notes stays a property row instead of becoming an author chip. Margin comments now write `tine.quote::`, `tine.quote-prefix::`, `tine.quote-suffix::` and `tine.author::`; the command line's `tine add` / `tine edit --author` write `tine.author::`; folder exports record their folder as `tine.export::`; and the Favorites, Today's sections and Exports pages are marked `tine.favorites::`, `tine.journal-sections::` and `tine.exports::`. Pages marked with the older `tine/favorites::`, `tine/journal-sections::` or `tine/exports::` keep working. **If you made comments or folder exports in a 0.9 Beta**, rename their properties with find/replace: on comment blocks and their replies `quote::` → `tine.quote::`, `quote-prefix::` → `tine.quote-prefix::`, `quote-suffix::` → `tine.quote-suffix::` and `author::` → `tine.author::`; on folder-export query blocks `export::` → `tine.export::` (in Org files the same keys appear as `:quote:`, `:author:`, `:export:` …). Leave `author::` on your other blocks alone (UI-PROPNAMES-USER-QUOTE, UI-PROPNAMES-USER-AUTHOR, REG-PROPNAMES-CLI-AUTHOR, REG-PROPNAMES-STABLE-MARKERS).

items.text: Macros in `config.edn` named with keywords, as Logseq writes them (`:macros {:bar "..."}`), now work like `"bar"` names. Before, `{{bar 5}}` stayed raw text, and every macro listed after the first keyword name was ignored as well (GH #854, REG-GH854-CONFIG-MACRO-KEYWORD-NAMES).
